1 / 8

Step by step

1

What Scan Office does

Scan Office is the office end of a gear check. The crew uses the free Scan Sheet app on their iPhones; you run Scan Office on the office Mac.

  • You bring in the equipment list and send crew lists to the phones.
  • The crew's counts, scans and notes come back as they work.
  • You answer what needs a person, then save the report for production.
  • Down the left side are the pages, in the order you work: Today, Lines, Lists and phones, Review, Results, Kits, Paperwork.
  • Job data stays on this laptop and the crew's phones. Nothing goes to the cloud.
2

Install

  1. Open the Scan Office 1.35.0 beta disk image (.dmg) you downloaded.
  2. Drag Scan Office onto the Applications folder in that window.
  3. Open Scan Office from Applications.
  4. If your Mac asks whether to open an app downloaded from the internet, click Open.
  5. If it asks to let Scan Office find devices on your local network, click Allow. Without it, phones can't find the office by themselves.
  6. It opens on Today with no job open. Nothing opens by itself.

Needs a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer. It does not run on Intel Macs.

3

Make a job from your equipment list

  1. On Today, click Import a list… (or File › Import…).
  2. Choose a file…: Excel (.xlsx) or .csv, in any layout. Your file is copied; it is never changed.
  3. Under What is this file?, check that Equipment list for a NEW job is picked.
  4. The top line sums up what was read, for example "Read 21 lines from 1 sheet: 17 ready, 4 other questions."
  5. Look over Columns. Yellow means a guess. If one is wrong, change it under This is.
  6. Check these lists the rows the import is unsure of. Long list? Open the full list.
  7. Type a Job name (it's blank when the list doesn't make the name clear).
  8. Click Start the job.

The import's questions wait on Review ("What needs a person"), one card per kind of problem, each with a do-all button or Show the lines: answer one by one. On Lines, the Need you filter shows the same lines.

PDFs, rental orders and photos of paperwork can't be imported in this beta. Import the spreadsheet behind them.

4

Turn on the phone link and pair each phone

  1. Go to Lists and phones › Phones and click Turn the link on (or Phones › Turn the link on in the menu).
  2. A 6-digit code shows. It's good for 10 minutes and for one phone. New code makes another.
  3. On the phone, in Scan Sheet: tap the gear at the top left of Home, then Office link › Set up. The first time, iPhone asks to find devices on the local network: say yes.
  4. Tap Office found: …, type the code, then Pair.
  5. Paired phones show under Paired phones. Do this once per phone.

Use a phone hotspot or a travel router. Venue, hotel and guest Wi-Fi usually keeps devices apart, so phones can't reach the office. Join the office Mac and every crew phone to the same hotspot or travel router. If it's a phone hotspot, use a phone that isn't scanning: the phone that is the hotspot can't reach the office from the app.

Office not showing up on the phone? Under Or type the office address, type the address the Phones page shows (for example 192.168.8.20:8772).

No link at all? Everything still works by file: the crew emails their results and you bring them in (step 6).

5

Send lists to the phones (or split one between crews)

  1. Lists and phones › Crew lists › Make a list…
  2. Under Kind, pick The whole manifest, Only these lines, Everything except these lines, or By case / type / group / ownership / make. Choosing by case or type is how you split a list between crews: make one list per crew.
  3. Give it a List name the crew will recognise.
  4. Under What for, choose Pull (prep / check out), Delivery (gear arriving), Return (wrap / check in), Manifest (customs / carnet) or Gear intake. The phone only asks for what that check needs.
  5. Click Make the list. Paired phones are offered it straight away.
  6. To give a list to one person, select it and click Assign to a phone or person…. Once any list is assigned, each phone sees only its own.

For an exact pick, tick lines on Lines and use Crew list › Make crew list from these lines… Phone not paired? Send the list file by AirDrop, Mail or Files; it opens in Scan Sheet. When a check is done: Done: take it back from crew.

The only warning about overlaps is a line that's on two active lists. Check the Problems phones and the office should see box on the Phones page.

6

Watch results come in and review them

  • Paired phones: every scan arrives as the crew works. Results › Live shows each change, newest first, with who, which phone, which list and when. The whole record keeps every change; an undo is a new record, nothing is erased.
  • Emailed results (.zip): Lists and phones › Results files › Add a results file…, then Look first to see every change it would bring, then Bring it in.
  • Lines shows where each line stands: Not checked yet, Still to check during a check, and Not found only after the crew has finished. You'll also see found counts like 4 / 6.
  • Review ("What needs a person") holds what needs a decision: damage, gear owed by the vendor, two counts that disagree, Not sure flags and the import's questions. Each card has its own buttons (for example Use 12 (Mike) / Use 11 (Sam), Recount, Noted…, Open item).
  • Today shows the job's steps with ticks and what's waiting for you.
7

The report, and the updated spreadsheet

  1. Paperwork › Report for production. It's for the production manager or the rental desk.
  2. Under Crew check, choose Every crew check or one list.
  3. Click Save as PDF…. It goes in the job's Outputs folder, ready to email.

The report is set out by case, with serials, who saw it and when. Its sections include Damaged, Back-ordered by the shop (coming later), Kits not here, Short kits, Owed by the vendor, Counts that disagree, Short counts, Not counted (no number on the list), Not found, Went somewhere else and Left for another crew. While a check is still open it says Still to check instead of Not found.

Paperwork › Spreadsheet › Write the next version writes v2 of the list, with changed cells tinted and a Change log tab, into the job's Outputs folder. Export / Send to job folder… copies it to your own job folder. Your original file is never changed.

8

Beta notes

  • The notice in Help › About Scan Office: "Beta. Free to use until March 2, 2027. Features in this beta may become part of a paid subscription later."
  • After March 2, 2027, Scan Office can't start new jobs. Jobs already on the laptop still open, take in crew results, review and export.
  • Mac only for now. The window title says "(beta)".
  • No cloud: job data stays on the office laptop and the crew's phones.
  • Feedback: what worked, what didn't, and where you got stuck, to paultlohr@gmail.com.

What the narrator says

Screens are from the Scan Office 1.35 beta code, drawn off screen with a made-up job ("Spring Tour 27", crew "Mike" and "Sam"). The phone-link screen was drawn with the link shown as on, without opening a real network. Folder paths in the pictures are shortened. The install scene and the phone are drawings.
